_comment: One-line descriptions for console commands, keyed by command name; consumed by gen_console.py. Missing keys render as [describe].
info: Print board, MCU and build information (the About screen's text).
scan: Sweep start..stop with the given point count and print data selected by the output mask (bit 1 frequencies, 2 S11, 4 S21, 8 raw/uncalibrated).
data: Print the current sweep data: 0 = S11, 1 = S21 (real imaginary per line); 2..6 dump the calibration arrays.
frequencies: Print the frequency of every sweep point, one per line.
freq: Set continuous-wave output at one frequency (stops the sweep).
sweep: Show or set the sweep: `sweep start [stop] [points]`, or `sweep {mode|freq|div|mul|...} value` for individual parameters.
power: Set the Si5351 output drive level 0..3 (2, 4, 6, 8 mA), or 255 for automatic.
offset: Show or set the IF (intermediate frequency) offset in Hz.
bandwidth: Show or set the IF bandwidth index (0 = widest/fastest; larger values narrow the filter and slow the sweep).
cal: Calibration control: collect a standard (`load`, `open`, `short`, `thru`, `isoln`), finish with `done`, `on`/`off` to apply, `reset` to clear.
save: Save the current calibration and settings to slot N.
recall: Recall calibration and settings from slot N.
trace: Show or set a trace: `trace N {format} [channel]`, `trace N off`, or scale/refpos.
marker: Show or set markers: `marker N on|off`, `marker N {index}`.
edelay: Show or set the electrical delay applied to S11 or S21, in seconds.
s21offset: Show or set the S21 level offset in dB (for an external attenuator).
capture: Dump the screen over the console (RLE8-compressed RGB565 framebuffer) for a PC-side screenshot.
reset: Reboot the device (`reset dfu` reboots into the USB DFU bootloader).
touchtest: Touch-screen test: draws where you touch until you release.
vbat: Print the battery voltage in millivolts.
vbat_offset: Show or set the battery-voltage measurement offset.
tcxo: Show or set the reference oscillator frequency (Hz) used by the clock generator.
threshold: Show or set the frequency above which harmonic mode is used.
clearconfig: Erase the saved configuration and calibration slots (needs the protection key 1234).
saveconfig: Save the device configuration to flash.
config: Show or set a device mode flag (see the list in the usage text).
transform: Time-domain transform control: on/off, impulse/step/bandpass, window minimum/normal/maximum.
smooth: Show or set the trace smoothing factor 0..8.
color: Set palette entry `id` to a 24-bit RGB colour.
measure: Select a MEASURE panel by name (see the list in the usage text).
sd_list: List files on the SD card matching a pattern.
sd_read: Print a file from the SD card over the console.
sd_delete: Delete a file from the SD card.
msg: Show a message box on the screen for `delay` milliseconds.
time: Show or set the real-time clock.
usart: Show or set the serial (UART) speed.
usart_cfg: Configure the UART: speed and mode.
vbat_offset: Show or set the battery-voltage measurement offset in millivolts.
scan_bin: Like `scan` but streams the results in a compact binary format (for PC software).
dump: Dump raw ADC samples from the codec for debugging.
touch: Inject a touch-down at x y (for automation and testing).
release: Inject a touch release (for automation and testing).
